title: Web Delta Feed: reproducible comparison reports for two saved text snapshots
description:
Web Delta Feed compares two already-saved UTF-8 text snapshots and writes a deterministic JSON report: source label and optional URL, the question being tracked, capture timestamps and SHA-256 hashes for both files, the exact added and removed lines, and case-insensitive matches for literal focus terms. Line alignment uses a patience-style diff with a standard-library fallback. Reports are byte-for-byte reproducible, written atomically and, on POSIX systems, readable only by their owner.

Scope: the program never fetches the URL, polls or monitors anything, and does not accept HTML. A changed line is reported, not interpreted; hashes show whether a saved file later changed, not that it is authentic or came from the labelled source.

Usage: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only; pip install . adds a web-delta-feed command. Run python3 web_delta_feed.py examples/before.txt examples/after.txt ... as shown in the README. Tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v (run in CI on Python 3.10 to 3.13 with coverage).

Citation: cite the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23069164 for all versions, or the version DOI of the release you used. Source code: github.com/sparkainlp-x/web-delta-feed. Licence: AGPL-3.0-only; commercial licensing is available (see COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md).
notes: Evidence status: SYNTHETIC example data; no field performance is claimed. Commercial licensing: see COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md.
